summary: Independent E2E confirmation of /app/locat-ui (React 19 + Vite UI kit, mock adapter) at http://127.0.0.1:3002/ — ALL 15 checklist items PASS on desktop 1280x800 and mobile 390x844. Auth (login + register validation), 4 seeded conversations, direct chat (bubbles, image, day dividers, pending->sent->bot reply->steel read receipt), composer (attach/image/mic, recording pill, voice message, Enter-to-send), message actions menu (Hide/Copy/Reply/Edit/Delete locally), in-conversation search, group chat + group dialog (5 members), drawer (all items, Light/Dark, 6 accents), People dialog (Friends/People/Requests/Group all functional), settings sheet save, profile dialog, design gallery with dialog+sheet overlays, responsive single-pane nav, sign out. ZERO browser console errors across all 7 test batches.

issues: Profile avatar button ('View X's profile') measures 38x38px — below the 44px minimum touch target guideline; all other header/composer controls are 44x44 (ChatWindow.tsx:142-150)

Edit message uses native window.prompt and Delete locally uses native window.confirm (MessageBubble.tsx:136,144) — functional but visually inconsistent with the smoked-glass design system and blocks Playwright clicks unless dialogs are awaited; consider smoked-glass confirm/edit dialogs
'Search conversations' nav item only closes the drawer (Drawer.tsx:65-67) — it does not open or focus the sidebar search input; minor, possibly intentional placeholder

action_items: Optional: bump chat-header profile avatar touch target from 38px to 44px
Optional: replace native window.prompt/confirm for Edit/Delete message with in-design smoked-glass overlays
Optional: wire drawer 'Search conversations' to focus the sidebar search input
No blocking defects — UI kit is ready for adapter integration
critical_code_review_comments: Clean architecture: all data flows through LocatUiAdapter seam (src/adapter.ts); no component talks to network directly; MockLocatAdapter clearly marked MOCK with simulated latency and bot replies

All files are small and focused (max 339 lines) — no >700 line violations; no DRY issues spotted; ACCENT_SWATCH map is duplicated between Drawer.tsx and SettingsSheet.tsx (12 lines) — could move to theme/tokens.ts
Accessibility: aria-labels on all icon buttons, role=dialog + aria-modal on Dialog/Sheet, Escape-to-close on all overlays, role=status on recording pill and Saved confirmation
Touch targets 44x44 on composer/header controls; min-h-11 on buttons/inputs; pt-safe/pb-safe on drawer/sheet/composer; zero horizontal overflow at 390px
Optimistic send with pending/failed states and settle-replace in ChatsScreen.tsx is correct; read receipts and bot replies flow through onEvent subscription with proper unsubscribe

success_rate.backend: N/A (frontend-only UI kit with intentional in-memory mock adapter)

seed_data_creation: None persistent — mock adapter is in-memory; test messages (e.g. 'Hello from the test agent', 'Test Group X') vanish on reload
context_for_next_testing_agent: App at http://127.0.0.1:3002/ (if down: cd /app/locat-ui && npx vite --port 3002 --host 0.0.0.0). Mock adapter accepts ANY username/password (used demo/demo-pass-123). Test harness gotchas: (1) Edit message/Delete locally use native window.prompt/confirm — in ASYNC Playwright you MUST await dialog.accept() inside asyncio.create_task or the click hangs 30s; (2) group dialog '(you)' row renders as 'Demo (you)' so exact-match text='(you)' fails; (3) Noah Reyes conversation pre-seeds 2 hidden messages so the hidden bar reads 'Hidden messages (3)' after hiding one more; (4) two elements share aria-label 'Close navigation' (backdrop + X) — use query_selector_all and pick the last. /app/memory/test_credentials.md credentials are for the OTHER app (/app/locat on port 3001), not this UI kit.
rca_of_issue: No app defects reproduced. Two test-harness false alarms root-caused: (a) 'mobile settings sheet NO SHEET' — my script clicked the drawer backdrop (first of two 'Close navigation' matches) then clicked settings 400ms later while the drawer was still animating out, so the backdrop intercepted; retested in isolation — sheet opens, saves, and Escape-closes correctly on mobile; (b) 'Hidden messages bar not found' — assertion expected count (1) but mock seeds 2 hidden messages in the Noah Reyes thread, so label was 'Hidden messages (3)'; hide/toggle/delete all verified working on retry.
